Businessman Vijay Mishra's Assets Seized in Maharashtra

Vijay Mishra, a businessman from the state of Maharashtra, has had his assets seized by the police. The seizure was made under gangster act and is believed to be related to illegal activities. This move raises questions about the government's efforts to tackle corruption and organized crime.
